name: Oops! I summoned a demon to do my homework and it actually worked
source:
You really shouldn't have procrastinated that assignment for Mr. Gold's Roman History class.

But here we are.
Summoning a demon for some reason.

Will they actually be able to help you with your homework.......?

Only one way to find out...

[From [url=https://bigmamafatcat.itch.io/oops]itch.io[/url]]
